class.name: OcgMessageProgressscope
class.brief_description: Message_ProgressScope class provides convenient way to advance progress indicator in context of complex program organized in hierarchical way, where usually it is difficult (or even not possible) to consider process as linear with fixed step.

method.name: default
method.description: Creates dummy scope. It can be safely passed to algorithms; no progress indication will be done.

method.name: UserBreak
method.description: Returns true if ProgressIndicator signals UserBreak

method.name: More
method.description: Returns false if ProgressIndicator signals UserBreak

method.name: Next
method.description: Advances position by specified step and returns the range covering this step

method.name: Show
method.description: Force update of presentation of the progress indicator. Should not be called concurrently.

method.name: IsActive
method.description: Returns true if this progress scope is attached to some indicator.

method.name: Name
method.description: Returns the name of the scope (may be null). Scopes with null name (e.g. root scope) should be bypassed when reporting progress to the user.

method.name: MaxValue
method.description: Returns the maximal value of progress in this scope

method.name: Value
method.description: Returns the current value of progress in this scope.

method.name: GetPortion
method.description: Get the portion of the indicator covered by this scope (from 0 to 1)

method.name: Close
method.description: Closes the scope and advances the progress to its end. Closed scope should not be used.
